cost.a: glot is MIT and free. You pay your LLM provider with your own key: 850 strings cost $0.035 with the default model in our run. glot translate --dry-run estimates first, and a budget caps it.

runtime.q: Does it add a runtime dependency?
runtime.a: No. Your app keeps next-intl, i18next or FormatJS with plain JSON catalogs. glot works on the files, in your repo and in CI.

fails.q: What if the model keeps getting a string wrong?
fails.a: glot sends the exact reason back and retries twice, then tries the fallback model. If it still fails, nothing is written: the key is reported as rejected and stays untranslated.

code.q: Does my code leave my machine?
code.a: The strings to translate and their context go to your LLM provider. Not your source files. Nothing goes to glot's authors; there is no telemetry.

app.q: Do I need the web app?
app.a: No. The CLI and the MCP server do the whole job locally. The app adds a shared dashboard, review and GitHub sync for teams.

how.title: Three steps. Your coding agent can run them too.

pick.title: Pick the words
pick.body: Choose a group of keys, like a hero's title, subtitle and button, so they change together. Name the audiences: country, language, device, traffic source.

write.title: Let AI write, let code check
write.body: Choose intentions such as social proof or simplicity. glot writes each variant in every locale and refuses any that break a rule, with the exact reason.

ship.title: Ship the winner
ship.body: glot shows each audience the best version, waits for real evidence, then opens a pull request with the winner. Your catalogs stay the source of truth.

guarantees.title: AI proposes. Code decides what visitors see.
guarantees.subtitle: The same validator that guards glot's translations runs on every variant, in every locale. A variant with a single failing locale never goes live.

placeholders.title: Placeholders and tags
placeholders.body: Same set as the source, none invented, none translated. ICU, i18next and MessageFormat 2.

plurals.title: Plurals
plurals.body: Every form the language needs: four in Polish, six in Arabic.

glossary.title: Your glossary
glossary.body: Product names stay put. Required and forbidden terms per language, in a file in your repo.

width.title: Pixel width
width.body: Measured with your app's real font and box. A variant too wide for its button is refused, never cut off.

patterns.title: No dark patterns
patterns.body: Fake urgency, fake activity counters, unprovable claims and confirmshaming are refused. Prices and legal mentions can't change.

facts.title: Only your facts
facts.body: A variant can only cite numbers you declared. “Join 10,000 teams” is refused unless 10,000 is on your list.

guarantees.patternsNote: Rules target practices EU consumer law already sanctions. A clean report means no known red flag, not legal advice.

results.title: Different audiences, different winners
results.subtitle: For every audience, glot says which version wins, by how much, and how sure it is, in one sentence. Not a p-value.
results.exampleSentence: Simplicity: +18% signups in Germany (probably between +6% and +30%), 97% probability it's the best. About 3 more days.

noEarly.title: No early calls.
noEarly.body: No winner before 7 days and 500 visitors per version, so one busy Monday never decides.

noFake.title: No fake winners.
noFake.body: The bar rises with every look, version and audience. Our test suite simulates experiments where nothing changes and fails if more than 5% of them declare a winner.

segment.title: Audience winners only when they're real.
segment.body: glot says “winner for Germany” only if Germany clearly beats the global result. Otherwise it recommends promoting everywhere.

traffic.title: Traffic goes to what works.
traffic.body: While learning, more visitors see the versions that look better. Every version keeps at least 10% until the end.

alarms.title: Alarms you can't miss.
alarms.body: If the traffic split looks wrong (a cache, a bot, a bug), decisions freeze and a red banner tells you why.

audiences.title: Up to 4 audiences.
audiences.body: Country, language, device, traffic source, new or returning visitor. Everyone else gets their own cell.

goals.title: Measure what converts, not what is clicked
goals.subtitle: A version wins on the event you care about, never on clicks alone.

goal.title: One goal that decides

path.title: Never on your critical path.

what.a: glot is an open-source (MIT) CLI and MCP server that localizes your app with your own LLM key, plus copy experiments: AI-written versions of your headlines, checked in every locale and served to each audience. Code refuses any text that breaks a placeholder, a plural, your glossary or its UI box.

audiences.q: Can I show different copy to different countries?
audiences.a: Yes. glot serves several versions of a headline or button to the audiences you choose (country, device, traffic source), in every language at once, and keeps the one that converts. Up to 4 audiences per experiment, plus everyone else.

ai.a: Every variant goes through the same checks as your translations, in every locale, plus rules against fake urgency, invented numbers and unprovable claims. You can require a human approval before any variant goes live.

facts.q: Can a variant invent a stat or a discount?
facts.a: No. A variant may only cite the facts you declare. Any number not in your text or your facts is refused. Keys tagged as pricing or legal can't be tested at all.

speed.q: Does it slow my site down or flicker?
speed.a: No blocking call. The edge picks the version from a cached file and your server renders it, so there is no flicker with server rendering. Client-only single-page apps may flicker on first paint. If glot is down, visitors get your official text.

cookies.q: Do I need a cookie banner for this?
cookies.a: glot sets no cookie by default and stores no IP, user agent or visitor ID, only daily counts. An optional session cookie holds the version, nothing else. Whether you need consent is your DPO's call; our privacy notes help.

seo.q: Does showing different copy hurt SEO?
seo.a: glot never picks a version based on the user agent. Crawlers get a version like any visitor, on the same URL with the same canonical, and bot visits are not counted. Versions keep the same meaning.

traffic.q: How much traffic do I need?
traffic.a: It depends on your traffic and conversion rate. When you create an experiment, glot estimates how long it will take and suggests merging an audience that would need more than 90 days. Start with one global experiment.

winner.q: How do I know a winner is real?
winner.a: glot waits at least 7 days and 500 visitors per version, raises the bar each time it looks, and can keep a small holdout to measure everything you promoted.

cost.a: The CLI, the validator and the local MCP server are MIT and free; you pay your LLM provider directly. glot cloud has a free plan with 1 experiment and paid Pro and Team plans with audiences. Self-host the server and nothing is limited.

formats.q: Which frameworks and file formats does glot support?
formats.a: Automatic string extraction: Next.js (App and Pages Router), React Router, Astro and Vite + React. Catalogs: JSON with ICU, i18next or MessageFormat 2 syntax, JS dictionaries, Apple .xcstrings and .strings, Android strings.xml, Flutter ARB, gettext PO and YAML.

agents.q: Which coding agents work with glot?
agents.a: Any agent that speaks MCP, such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Windsurf, through npx -y glot-i18n mcp. Claude Code also has a glot plugin and skill, and AGENTS.md rules are provided for other agents.

pricing.title: Free where it runs on your machine. Paid where it runs on ours.

oss.title: Open source: free, forever

oss.q: Is anything in the open-source tool limited?
oss.a: No. Quotas only apply to requests served by glot cloud. The CLI, the local MCP server and the GitHub Action never call the billing system.

byok.a: With your own LLM key, you pay your provider directly and glot counts nothing. Without a key, the cloud can use glot's key: each plan includes a monthly amount, and monthly plans can continue with usage-based billing.

selfHost.q: Can I self-host the cloud features?
selfHost.a: Yes. The server is in the same MIT repository. Without Stripe keys, billing is off and every limit is lifted.

limits.q: What happens when I reach a quota?
limits.a: The cloud endpoint answers 402 with a message and an upgrade link; your shipped catalogs keep working from your repository. Quotas reset on the 1st of each month (UTC).

tax.a: Payments, invoices and VAT are handled by Stripe. Invoices are in your billing settings; business customers can add a VAT number at checkout.

audience.name: Segment {n}
audience.countryHint: Two-letter codes, separated by commas. Leave empty for all countries.
audience.visitorHint: New vs returning is only known for visitors who accepted cookies on your site; others count as Everyone else.

reviewPage.title: Review
reviewPage.subtitle: Annotate your live site with your team, fix the wording and ship it.
reviewPage.openPanel: {count, plural, =0 {Annotations} one {# open annotation} other {# open annotations}}
reviewPage.panelHint: Every annotation on this project, with filters, discussion and text editing.

noSite.title: Connect your site to review it
noSite.body: Review shows your live site with your team's annotations on top. Set your site's base URL first; it takes 30 seconds.

installDialog.title: Install the glot widget
installDialog.body: One line in your site's HTML. It lets your team annotate right on the page and lets Review place pins precisely.
installDialog.frameTitle: Only want pins in this page?
installDialog.frameBody: If you can't add the widget, this smaller script is enough for Review to place pins and preview edits. Your site must also allow being shown in a frame (no X-Frame-Options DENY, and CSP frame-ancestors must include this dashboard).

help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.body: Single-key shortcuts work when you are not typing in a field.
help.c: Comment on a text in the site

frame.title: Your site: {url}

unreachable.title: Live pins unavailable.
unreachable.body: Your site did not answer inside the frame: the glot widget is not on this page, or your site forbids framing (X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors).
unreachable.fix: To allow glot only, remove X-Frame-Options and send:

frame.picking: Click the text you want. Press Esc to cancel.
frame.annotating: Click a text in your site to leave a comment. Press Esc to cancel.
frame.pickingBlind: The site can't report clicks yet. Install the widget, or switch to the last screenshot and click there.
frame.shotAlt: Last screenshot of this page from visual QA

empty.title: No annotations yet
empty.body: Press C or click Comment, then click any text in your site to start a discussion.
empty.widgetTitle: Install the widget in one line
empty.widgetBody: Paste this in your site's HTML so your team, and reviewers you invite by link, can annotate directly on the page.

list.resolvedThisWeek: {count, plural, one {# annotation resolved this week} other {# annotations resolved this week}}
list.author: Author
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No annotations match} one {# annotation} other {# annotations}}
list.label: Annotations

composer.title: New annotation
composer.noText: No text was detected at this spot; the annotation will be pinned to the position.
composer.bodyHint: Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, links. Mention a teammate with @Name. Ctrl+Enter to send.
composer.suggestionHint: What the text should say instead. You can apply it in one click later.

detail.title: Annotation {n}
detail.deleteBody: {count, plural, =0 {The annotation will be removed for everyone.} one {The annotation and its reply will be removed for everyone.} other {The annotation and its # replies will be removed for everyone.}}

wording.title: Fix the wording
wording.variants: Pick a version, hover to preview it
wording.allLocales: Validated in {count, plural, one {# language} other {# languages}}
wording.previewHint: Previewed live in the site while you type. Nothing is saved until you apply.
wording.applyAll: Apply in {count, plural, one {# language} other {# languages}}
wording.applied: Translation saved for {locale} and annotation resolved
wording.failed: The translation couldn't be saved. Try again.
wording.prNeedsSettings: Set a repository and token in User reports › Settings to open pull requests.
wording.noKey: This text isn't linked to a translation key yet, so it can't be changed from here. Create a key first.
wording.invalidProposal: Fails validation in at least one language
wording.showLocales: See all {count, plural, one {# language} other {# languages}}
wording.rejected: {count, plural, one {# version was discarded because it broke a rule (placeholder, glossary, length).} other {# versions were discarded because they broke a rule (placeholder, glossary, length).}}

editor.title: Edit text
editor.createTitle: Create a key from this text
editor.createBody: This text isn't in your catalog: it's probably hard-coded. glot adds it as a source string; a developer then replaces the literal in the code (glot i18nize or a pull request).
editor.keyHint: Leave empty to generate one from the page and the text.
editor.descriptionHint: Where the text appears and what it does, e.g. "Button that starts the free trial".
editor.saved: {count, plural, one {# translation saved} other {# translations saved}}
editor.invalid: Nothing was saved: fix the errors shown under each language.
editor.protected: Placeholders in braces are filled in by your app: keep each one. Click a chip to insert it.
editor.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
editor.empty: Empty text. To remove this translation, use Remove.
editor.removeBody: Your site will show the fallback (usually the source text) for this language. The history is kept, so you can restore it.

share.title: Share for review
share.body: Reviewers open your site with this link and annotate it, no account needed. Links can be revoked at any time.
share.adminOnly: Only project admins can create review links. Ask an admin to share one.
share.label: Name (optional)

accessHint.read: Sees annotations and discussions, can't write.
accessHint.edit: Also edits texts, changes statuses and applies suggestions.

share.createdTitle: Link ready. Copy it now: it won't be shown again.
share.createdHint: Anyone with this link gets the permission above until it expires or you revoke it.
share.active: {count, plural, =0 {Active links} one {# active link} other {# active links}}
